purpose: R1.18 — the first read-only admin review slice: /drafts shows a bounded FIRST PAGE (≤5 visible rows + 1 probe row for honest has-more, ONE parameterized indexed SELECT over idx_drafts_status_time verified by a real EXPLAIN — no COUNT(*), no OFFSET, no pagination machinery, no document_json loads) and /drafts <draftId> shows ONE stored draft by its EXACT validated id (ONE parameterized PK SELECT with a SQL byte-length guard — documents above 128 KiB UTF-8 are never transferred; the typed too-large state shows safe metadata only). The detail view composes: stored IDs/version/status with the explicit ready = stored draft, NOT approved/published notice; Persian headline/summary; bounded source name and IMMUTABLE sourceReport excerpt with the saved snapshot identity; bounded UNVERIFIED model-claim samples with cited evidence ids; the Evidence Guard v1 direct-text/unresolved summary with the headline/summary unassessed warning; candidate discovery/assessment and entity-mention summaries as historical observations; and the event-relation ledger (≤2 pairs) with the proposal-vs-technical distinction preserved verbatim (*_proposed = proposal only; technical states are technical, never semantic verdicts; missing candidate ≠ unrelated). All five stored reports are read through the EXISTING strict typed readers (readEventRelationDecision on the JSON STRING; the others on the parsed document) so absent/unsupported_version/malformed stay VISIBLE and distinct per report — a corrupt optional report never crashes the preview and never displays as a zero/no-match. Rendering is budget-first: ≤3500 UTF-16 code units including escaped HTML, per-section budgets decided before composition, code-point-safe truncation that never slices an entity or a surrogate pair, one explicit display_truncated notice, always valid Telegram-safe HTML. The gate ADMIN_REVIEW_ENABLED is fail-closed (absent=false; an invalid-present value records the config issue and stays disabled — never truthy-coerced); while OFF the commands keep the exact unknown-command noop semantics with ZERO editorial queries and /help never advertises the surface. Access requires an authorized numeric actor with the EXISTING blueprint draft.view permission, a PRIVATE chat and a FRESH message; group/channel/edited/other-bot/unsupported contexts retrieve nothing and disclose nothing; unknown/disabled actors and source_manager are denied without content or existence disclosure.
